ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: For the closed-loop system shown, the transfer function \(\frac{E(s)}{R(s)}\) is ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a standard negative-feedback closed-loop system. The reference input R(s) enters the summing point from the left and is marked with a positive sign; the feedback signal returns to the summing point from below through the H block and is marked with a negative sign at that input terminal. The output of the summing point is labeled E(s), then enters the forward-path block G, and the output is C(s). The output C(s) is also branched downward, passes through the feedback block H, and then returns to the negative input terminal of the summing point. Reasoning: From the block diagram, C(s)=G E(s) can be written. The feedback signal is H C(s)=H G E(s). Since it is negative feedback, the error signal E(s)=R(s)-H C(s). Substituting C(s)=G E(s), we get E(s)=R(s)-H G E(s). Rearranging gives E(s)(1+GH)=R(s), therefore E(s)/R(s)=1/(1+GH).
